sentence: O tempo não está nada bom hoje.
ipa: o ˈtẽpu ˈnɐ̃w̃ eˈʃta ˈnadɐ ˈbõ ˈɔʒɨ
gloss_en: The weather is not good at all today.
notes: Preconsonantal coda 's' keeps the inherited pan-EP chiado [ʃ] in 'está' per cintra1971; unstressed reduction and nasal [õ] in 'bom' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Estas botas custam vinte e nove euros.
ipa: ˈeʃtɐs̺ ˈbɔtɐs̺ ˈkuʃtɐ̃w̃ ˈbĩt i ˈnɔbɨ ˈewɾus̺
gloss_en: These boots cost twenty-nine euros.
notes: Northern betacism 'vinte'/'nove'->[ˈbĩtɨ]/[ˈnɔbɨ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; word-final apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'botas'/'euros' and preconsonantal chiado [ʃ] in 'estas' per cintra1971.

sentence: A reunião é amanhã às três da tarde.
ipa: ɐ ʁewniˈɐ̃w̃ ˈɛ ɐmɐˈɲã as̺ ˈtɾes̺ dɐ ˈtaɾdɨ
gloss_en: The meeting is tomorrow at three in the afternoon.
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'reunião' and palatal [ɲ] in 'amanhã' per mateus_dandrade2000; word-final apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'às'/'três' per cintra1971.

sentence: O meu irmão vive perto do rio.
ipa: o ˈmew iˈɾmɐ̃w̃ ˈbibɨ ˈpɛɾtu du ˈʁiu
gloss_en: My brother lives near the river.
notes: Betacism to plain [b] 'vive'->[ˈbibɨ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'irmão' and 'meu irmão' liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Segue em frente e vira na segunda rua.
ipa: ˈs̺ɨɡɨ ɐ̃j̃ ˈfɾẽt i ˈbiɾɐ nɐ s̺ɨˈɡũdɐ ˈʁuɐ
gloss_en: Keep straight ahead and turn on the second street.
notes: Apico-alveolar [s̺] onset in 'segue'/'segunda' per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; betacism 'vira'->[ˈbiɾɐ] and 'segue em' liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A sopa de peixe estava deliciosa.
ipa: ɐ ˈs̺opɐ dɨ ˈpejʃ eˈʃtabɐ dɨlisiˈɔz̺ɐ
gloss_en: The fish soup was delicious.
notes: Apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'sopa', voiced apical [z̺] in 'deliciosa' and betacism 'estava'->[eˈʃtabɐ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; 'ei' diphthong in 'peixe' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Onde é que apanho o autocarro?
ipa: ˈõdɨ ˈɛ kɨ ɐˈpaɲu o awtuˈkaʁu
gloss_en: Where do I catch the bus?
notes: Palatal [ɲ] in 'apanho' and strong [ʁ] in 'autocarro' per mateus_dandrade2000; 'que apanho o' liaisons per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Quantas pessoas vêm ao jantar?
ipa: kwɐ̃ˈtɐs̺ pɨˈs̺ɔɐs̺ ˈbɐ̃j̃ ɐu ʒɐ̃ˈtaɾ
gloss_en: How many people are coming to dinner?
notes: Betacism 'vêm'->[ˈbẽ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'pessoas' and preconsonantal chiado [ʃ] in 'quantas' per cintra1971.

sentence: Se eu pudesse, comprava aquela vinha.
ipa: s̺ɨ ˈew puˈdɛs̺ɨ kõˈpɾabɐ ɐˈkɛlɐ ˈbiɲɐ
gloss_en: If I could, I would buy that vineyard.
notes: Apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'se'/'pudesse' and betacism with palatal 'vinha'->[ˈbiɲɐ], 'comprava'->[kõˈpɾabɐ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014.

sentence: Comprámos vinho e uvas na feira.
ipa: kõˈpɾamus̺ ˈbiɲu i ˈubɐs̺ nɐ ˈfejɾɐ
gloss_en: We bought wine and grapes at the market.
notes: Betacism to plain [b] 'vinho'/'uvas'->[ˈbiɲu]/[ˈubɐs̺] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; 'ei' diphthong in 'feira' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Amanhã vamos de barco até à ilha.
ipa: ɐmɐˈɲã ˈbamus̺ dɨ ˈbaɾku ɐˈtɛ a ˈiʎɐ
gloss_en: Tomorrow we go by boat to the island.
notes: Betacism 'vamos'->[ˈbamus̺] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; palatal [ɲ] in 'amanhã', [ʎ] in 'ilha' and 'até à' liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Telefona-me quando chegares a casa.
ipa: tɨlɨˈfɔnɐ mɨ ˈkwɐ̃du tʃɨˈɡaɾɨs̺ ɐ ˈkaz̺ɐ
gloss_en: Call me when you get home.
notes: Archaic onset affricate: 'ch' = [tʃ] in 'chegares'->[tʃɨˈɡaɾɨs̺] per cintra1971; voiced apico-alveolar [z̺] in 'casa' per alvarezperez2014.

sentence: Boa tarde, então como tens passado?
ipa: ˈboɐ ˈtaɾd ẽˈtɐ̃w̃ ˈkomu ˈtẽs̺ pɐˈs̺adu
gloss_en: Good afternoon, so how have you been?
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'então' per mateus_dandrade2000; apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'passado' and word-final [s̺] in 'tens' per cintra1971.

sentence: Mais vale um pássaro na mão que dois a voar.
ipa: ˈmajs̺ ˈbalɨ ˈũ ˈpas̺ɐɾu nɐ ˈmɐ̃w̃ kɨ ˈdojs̺ ɐ buˈaɾ
gloss_en: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
notes: Betacism 'vale'/'voar'->[ˈbalɨ]/[buˈaɾ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'pássaro' and nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'mão' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O gato cinzento dorme no sofá.
ipa: o ˈɡatu sĩˈzẽtu ˈdɔɾmɨ nu s̺uˈfa
gloss_en: The grey cat sleeps on the sofa.
notes: Four-sibilant contrast: laminal 'cinzento'->[sĩˈzẽtu] (from c/z) stays distinct from the apical [s̺] of 'sofá' per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014.

sentence: Aquele rato fugiu para o buraco.
ipa: ɐˈkɛlɨ ˈʁatu fuˈʒiw ˈpaɾɐ o buˈɾaku
gloss_en: That mouse ran into the hole.
notes: Strong initial [ʁ] in 'rato' and reduced pretonics per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O mundo inteiro fala deste assunto.
ipa: o ˈmũdu ĩˈtejɾu ˈfalɐ ˈdɛʃtɨ ɐˈs̺ũtu
gloss_en: The whole world talks about this subject.
notes: Nasal 'mundo'->[ˈmũdu] and 'ei' diphthong in 'inteiro' per mateus_dandrade2000; apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'assunto' and preconsonantal chiado [ʃ] in 'deste' per cintra1971.

sentence: A avó vende ovos e couves no mercado.
ipa: ɐ ɐˈbɔ ˈbẽdɨ ˈobus̺ i ˈkobɨs̺ nu mɨˈɾkadu
gloss_en: Grandmother sells eggs and cabbages at the market.
notes: Betacism to plain [b] 'avó'/'ovos'/'couves'->[ɐˈbɔ]/[ˈobus̺]/[ˈkobɨs̺] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; 'ou' diphthong in 'couves' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O sol brilha por cima do vale.
ipa: o ˈs̺ɔɫ ˈbɾiʎɐ puɾ ˈsimɐ du ˈbalɨ
gloss_en: The sun shines over the valley.
notes: Velarised coda [ɫ] in 'sol' and palatal [ʎ] in 'brilha' per mateus_dandrade2000; laminal [s] in 'cima' vs apical elsewhere and betacism 'vale'->[ˈbalɨ] per cintra1971.

sentence: Chove muito e o chão está molhado.
ipa: ˈtʃɔbɨ ˈmujtu i o ˈtʃɐ̃w̃ eˈʃta muˈʎadu
gloss_en: It rains a lot and the ground is wet.
notes: Archaic onset affricate 'ch' = [tʃ] with betacism 'chove'->[ˈtʃɔbɨ], 'chão'->[ˈtʃɐ̃w̃] per cintra1971; palatal [ʎ] in 'molhado' per mateus_dandrade2000.
